cases.prompt: Refresh the progress board for the project in drift-shop/ and tell me where things stand.
expected_behavior: Reports that T-002 has conflicting stages: BUILD in .tickets/T-002.md and COMPLETE in .plan/board/stages.yaml
Leaves both source files unchanged and asks the user which one to fix
Writes drift-shop/.plan/board/board.json with a drift entry for T-002

check.cmd: grep -q 'Stage: BUILD' drift-shop/.tickets/T-002.md && grep -q 'T-002: COMPLETE' drift-shop/.plan/board/stages.yaml && grep -q 'stage-mismatch' drift-shop/.plan/board/board.json

cases.prompt: T-002 in shipped-shop/ just merged and I set it to COMPLETE. Update the board so the cycle record shows it.
expected_behavior: Runs refresh rather than editing board.json or history.jsonl by hand
history.jsonl keeps its two original lines and gains exactly one line with ticket T-002, from REVIEW, to COMPLETE
Does not edit any file under shipped-shop/.tickets/

cases.prompt: I'm in a terminal agent with no canvas. Set up a board for terminal-shop/ that I can open in a browser and commit with the repo.
expected_behavior: Runs init for terminal-shop/ and exports the html target
Writes a single HTML file with the board data inside a script tag with id board-data
Gives the path to the HTML file and the OS command to open it

cases.prompt: Show me a brief for brief-shop/: what we're building, what done means for each ticket, and what proves each stage. Give me markdown I can paste into a PR.
expected_behavior: Runs init or refresh, then exports the md target
The markdown shows the PRD goal sentence about clinics losing slots, T-001's two criteria with one checked, and T-002's criterion taken from task-sequence.md
Says the stage exit rules are generic defaults and points to stage_rules in config.json
Leaves PRD.md, task-sequence.md and both ticket files unchanged

check.cmd: grep -q 'Opt-in only' brief-shop/.plan/PRD.md && grep -q '\[ \] Skips patients' brief-shop/.tickets/T-001.md && python3 -c "import json,sys; b=json.load(open('brief-shop/.plan/board/board.json')); t={x['id']:x for x in b['tickets']}; sys.exit(0 if b['brief']['overview']['title']=='Appointment reminders' and t['T-002']['acceptance'][0]['text'].startswith('Patients can') and b['brief']['stage_rules_source']=='default' else 1)"

cases.prompt: Write the trackboard brief for chat-shop/ from our planning chat in chat-shop/notes/planning-chat.md.
expected_behavior: Writes chat-shop/.plan/board/brief.md with Building, Not building, Spec and Proof sections and the three frontmatter keys
Ends every claim line in Building, Not building and Proof with a source tag such as [D1], [T-002] or [chat 2030-02-03]
Adds no acceptance criteria: no checkboxes, no AC: lines, and no requirement the chat did not state
Takes covers from brief-hash, runs refresh, and reports no brief_untagged warning

check.cmd: f=chat-shop/.plan/board/brief.md; test -f $f && test $(grep -cE '^## (Building|Not building|Spec|Proof)$' $f) -eq 4 && awk '/^## /{s=($0 ~ /^## (Building|Not building|Proof)/); next} s && NF && $0 !~ /\]$/ {bad=1} END{exit bad}' $f && ! grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*[-*] \[[ xX]\]|AC:' $f && grep -q '^covers: sha256:' $f && grep -q 'survives a restart' chat-shop/.tickets/T-001.md
